simple.meaning: מוֹבָא (môwbâʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an entrance.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Samuel 3:25. The surrounding context includes family line, Torah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹבָא (H4126) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
